title: Loki
description: Loki 3.7 in monolithic mode (single pod loki-0, filesystem storage, TSDB index, 7-day retention): ingestion, queries, ingester/WAL, compactor/retention and resources, using only metrics this deployment exports. Curated from the official loki-mixin (https://github.com/grafana/loki/tree/main/production/loki-mixin: loki-writes, loki-reads, loki-chunks, loki-retention, loki-resources) and the chart's loki_alerts rules. The chart's own dashboards are off on purpose (they target the distributed mode).

list.name: Firing alerts
list.expr: ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname=~"Loki.*"} or ALERTS{alertstate="firing", namespace="monitoring", pod=~"loki-[0-9]+"}
list.textFormat: Prometheus ALERTS series in state firing. See Alertmanager / alert rules for details.

list.name: Container restarts
list.textFormat: kube-state-metrics saw the restart counter change (crash, OOMKill or liveness failure).

list.name: Retention runs
list.textFormat: The compactor deleted chunks older than retention_period (168h).

options.content:
**Loki** stores the lab's logs. Writers: `otel-logs` (pod logs from /var/log/pods + Kubernetes events) and
`otel-gateway` (OTLP logs from apps), both over OTLP/HTTP (`/otlp/v1/logs`). Readers: Grafana (Explore,
trace -> logs links), the Loki ruler is not used. Monolithic: one process runs distributor, ingester, querier,
query-frontend and compactor; data lives on the node disk (local-path).

**Healthy**: Up, ingestion steady (a few KB/s), *Discarded* 0, push p99 < 1s, push 5xx 0%, query 5xx ~0%,
WAL failures 0, last retention run < 2h ago, node disk < 70%.

**When red**
- *Discarded > 0* → the *Discarded samples by reason* panel says why (rate limit, too old, line too long...).
  Collectors retry on 429 but drop on 4xx.
- *Push 5xx / latency* → Loki is overloaded or the disk is full; otel-logs queues grow (OpenTelemetry Collectors dashboard).
- *Query 5xx* → usually a query that is too large or times out (mixin alert LokiRequestErrors fires above 10% 5xx for 15m).
- *WAL / disk* → node root filesystem filling: Loki, Prometheus and Tempo share it.
- Logs: `kubectl --context k8s01 -n monitoring logs loki-0 -c loki`.

Formulas: [loki-mixin](https://github.com/grafana/loki/tree/main/production/loki-mixin); alert thresholds from the chart's `loki_alerts` group.

panels.title: Active alerts for this service
panels.description: Prometheus alerts of this service that are FIRING (condition true for longer than the rule's `for`) or PENDING (condition true, waiting for `for`). Same filter as the red alert annotations of this dashboard; Watchdog/InfoInhibitor are excluded. Empty = healthy. Alertmanager has no receiver in this lab, so dashboards are where alerts are seen: the rule, its threshold and source are in the rule files (helm-charts/<app>/**/prometheus.rules.yaml or the -raw release) and in docs/dashboards/. All alerts of the lab: dashboard "Alerts overview" (Observability folder).

targets.expr: ALERTS{alertname!~"Watchdog|InfoInhibitor", alertstate=~"firing|pending", alertname=~"Loki.*"} or ALERTS{alertname!~"Watchdog|InfoInhibitor", alertstate=~"firing|pending", namespace="monitoring", pod=~"loki-[0-9]+"}

panels.title: Up
panels.description: Scrape health of Loki (`up`).

panels.title: Ingestion
panels.description: Bytes per second received by the distributor (`loki_distributor_bytes_received_total`, mixin loki-writes). Before compression; the main driver of disk use.

panels.title: Lines / s
panels.description: Log lines per second received (`loki_distributor_lines_received_total`).

panels.title: Active streams
panels.description: Streams held in ingester memory (`loki_ingester_memory_streams`). A stream = one unique label set; a sudden jump means a high-cardinality label was added to logs.

panels.title: Discarded (1h)
panels.description: Log lines rejected in the last hour (`loki_discarded_samples_total`). Any value means logs were lost; see 'Discarded samples by reason'.

panels.title: Push 5xx
panels.description: Share of push requests answered with 5xx over 5m (loki_alerts LokiRequestErrors uses the same ratio per route, critical above 10% for 15m).

panels.title: Panics (1h)
panels.description: Recovered panics in request handlers (`loki_panic_total`). loki_alerts LokiRequestPanics (critical) fires on any increase in 10m.

panels.title: Node disk used
panels.description: Root filesystem of the node, where local-path keeps the Loki volume (hostPath PVs report no kubelet volume stats, so the node filesystem is the real limit). node-exporter alerts NodeFilesystemAlmostOutOfSpace fire at 5%/3% free.

panels.title: Restarts (24h)
panels.description: Container restarts of loki in the last 24h (kube-state-metrics). After a restart the ingester replays the WAL before it accepts writes.

panels.title: Bytes received by tenant
panels.description: Uncompressed bytes per second per tenant (`loki_distributor_bytes_received_total`, mixin loki-writes). auth_enabled=false, so everything is tenant `fake`.

panels.title: Lines received by tenant
panels.description: Lines per second per tenant (`loki_distributor_lines_received_total`).

panels.title: Discarded samples by reason
panels.description: Rejected lines per second by reason (`loki_discarded_samples_total`). too_far_behind / out_of_order: entry older than the newest of its stream; rate_limited / per_stream_rate_limit: tenant or stream over limits_config rates; line_too_long; greater_than_max_sample_age (reject_old_samples). Empty = nothing discarded.

panels.title: Push requests by route / status
panels.description: Write requests per second by route (otlp_v1_logs = OTLP, loki_api_v1_push = native) and status (`loki_request_duration_seconds_count`, mixin loki-writes 'QPS'). 204 = accepted; 4xx = rejected (not retried by collectors); 5xx/429 = retried.

panels.title: Push latency
panels.description: p99 / p50 of write requests (mixin loki-writes 'Latency'). loki_alerts LokiRequestLatency fires when a route's p99 is above 1s for 15m.

panels.title: Structured metadata received
panels.description: Bytes per second of structured metadata (OTLP resource/log attributes that are not promoted to labels, e.g. trace_id) - `loki_distributor_structured_metadata_bytes_received_total`. Counts against the ingestion rate limit too.

panels.title: Query requests by route / status
panels.description: Read requests per second by route and status (`loki_request_duration_seconds_count`, mixin loki-reads 'QPS'). Empty when nothing queried Loki in the window (Grafana Explore, dashboards). 400 = bad LogQL, 5xx = server error/timeout.

panels.title: Query latency
panels.description: p99 / p50 of read requests (mixin loki-reads 'Latency'). Same 1s threshold as LokiRequestLatency; long range queries legitimately take longer.

panels.title: Queries in progress / scheduler queue
panels.description: Queries running in the query-frontend (`loki_query_frontend_queries_in_progress`), scheduler inflight p99 (`loki_query_scheduler_inflight_requests`, summary) and queries executing in querier workers. Growing values = queries queueing.

panels.title: Query result cache
panels.description: Log result cache hits / misses in the query-frontend (`loki_query_frontend_log_result_cache_*`). The external results cache is disabled; this is the in-process negative-result cache.

panels.title: Chunks per query
panels.description: Chunks fetched per query (`loki_chunk_store_chunks_per_query`, mixin loki-reads). High values = broad selectors / long ranges; narrow label selectors make queries cheaper.

panels.title: Index (TSDB) request latency
panels.description: p99 latency of TSDB index lookups by operation (`loki_index_request_duration_seconds`, mixin loki-reads 'Index').

panels.title: Streams in memory / created / removed
panels.description: Active streams and churn (`loki_ingester_memory_streams`, `loki_ingester_streams_created_total`, `..._removed_total`; mixin loki-chunks). High churn = short-lived label values (pod names come and go).

panels.title: Chunks flushed / failures
panels.description: Chunks flushed to storage per minute by reason (full, idle, max_age...), flush failures and flush queue length (mixin loki-chunks 'Flush'). Failures = disk problems; a growing queue = disk too slow.

panels.title: Chunk utilization / compression
panels.description: Median chunk fill ratio at flush (`loki_ingester_chunk_utilization`) and compression ratio (`loki_ingester_chunk_compression_ratio`), mixin loki-chunks. Low utilization = many small chunks (idle streams flushed early).

panels.title: Bytes stored (filesystem)
panels.description: Compressed chunk bytes written to the filesystem object store (`loki_chunk_store_stored_chunk_bytes_total`, `loki_ingester_chunk_stored_bytes_total`). Times 7 days of retention ~ disk needed.

panels.title: WAL
panels.description: Write-ahead log of the ingester (replayed after a restart): bytes in use and bytes logged per second (`loki_ingester_wal_bytes_in_use`, `loki_ingester_wal_logged_bytes_total`).

panels.title: WAL disk usage / failures
panels.description: WAL disk usage percent as seen by Loki (`loki_ingester_wal_disk_usage_percent`, 0-1), writes refused because the disk is full (`loki_ingester_wal_disk_full_failures_total`) and failed checkpoints. Failures must stay 0: with a full disk Loki keeps data only in memory.

panels.title: Last retention run
panels.description: Seconds since the compactor last applied retention successfully (`loki_compactor_apply_retention_last_successful_run_timestamp_seconds`, mixin loki-retention). It runs every 10m by default; > 2h means retention is stuck and the disk keeps growing.

panels.title: Last TSDB index build
panels.description: Seconds since the TSDB index was last built and shipped (`loki_tsdb_build_index_last_successful_timestamp_seconds`). Built periodically from the head; old values mean index files are not being uploaded.

panels.title: Pending delete requests
panels.description: Log deletion requests waiting to be processed (`loki_compactor_pending_delete_requests_count`) and the oldest one's age. Only non-zero when someone used the delete API.

panels.title: Retention / index operations
panels.description: Retention runs and TSDB index builds per hour by status (`loki_compactor_apply_retention_operation_total`, `loki_tsdb_build_index_attempts_total`). status=fail needs the compactor logs.

panels.title: CPU (cores)
panels.description: CPU used by the container (cAdvisor `container_cpu_usage_seconds_total`, rate) against its request (kube-state-metrics). No CPU limit is set in this lab (requests only), so the container can burst; sustained use far above the request means the request should be raised so the scheduler accounts for it. Formula: kubernetes-mixin 'Compute Resources / Pod' dashboard.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Working set (what the kernel OOM-killer looks at) against the memory request and limit. The working set reaching the limit means an OOMKill (watch the restart annotation). Formula: kubernetes-mixin 'Compute Resources / Pod' dashboard (container_memory_working_set_bytes).

panels.title: Goroutines / log messages
panels.description: Goroutines (leaks grow without bound) and Loki's own log lines per minute by level (`loki_internal_log_messages_total`): a rise in level=error is the quickest hint something broke.

panels.title: Disk: node root filesystem
panels.description: The Loki volume is a local-path hostPath directory on this filesystem; kubelet exports no per-volume stats for it. Node used vs size, plus Loki's WAL size.
